verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a SaaS verification product with a dashboard, but the evidence shows no in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server, llms.txt and CLI let external agents and developers work with the Stripe API, which is a different capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
